substantive_evaluations.collective_statement_most_likely_to_succ: Candidate #2 (01__19559972-RESPONSE-BALANCED-10182026.tex) represents the optimal, professionally poised response that will be received and processed most effectively by Pre-Exam (OPAP) and the Office of Petitions. It flawlessly articulates the rollover of the response deadline from Sunday, October 18, 2026 to Monday, October 19, 2026 pursuant to 35 U.S.C. § 21(b) and 37 CFR § 1.7. It systematically itemizes every required remedial submission—including the substitute specification under 37 CFR § 1.125 excising embedded drawings and claims, formal standalone drawing sheets under 37 CFR § 1.84, standalone abstract under 37 CFR § 1.72(b), and the compliant AIA Inventor Declaration under 37 CFR § 1.63(a)(4). Furthermore, its execution of the Waterfall Path B knapsack fee allocation directive under 37 CFR § 1.22(b) and MPEP § 509 is mathematically sound ($446.00 credits applied across codes 4011, 2051, and 2111, with $524.00 fresh funds plus $60.00 for conditional suspension). Crucially, unlike the Assertive and Equitable drafts, Candidate #2 avoids contentious rhetoric concerning external district court litigation or allegations regarding funds held across the macro portfolio, preserving a focused, compliant administrative posture.

However, Candidate #2 excels by adhering strictly to the administrative framework of pre-examination processing without introducing extraneous legal vulnerabilities or antagonistic language.
